title: Can I BEAT Labyrinth 82?
summary: 'Labyrinth 82': 4-player chess.com custom variant on a board littered with impenetrable stone wall squares forming a maze. Each king survives 8 checks; pawns promote on the 2nd rank (each player starts with two pawns that promote to a piece of choice almost immediately). Winner = most points; checkmates are 20 points. He plays 3 games (opponents incl. 'Plankton' 2100, Megan, JMeister) and technically wins game 3 on points.
rules: 4-player FFA; each player's king survives 8 checks (the 8th/next check = mated).
Pawns promote on the 2nd rank (relative); each side starts with 2 pawns; moving a pawn twice (double-step) skips past the promotion square so it does not promote.
Stone wall squares are impenetrable: nothing can enter or slide through them.
Points: captures score piece value (promoted pawn worth 1); checkmate = 20 points.
Eliminated/resigned players' kings become bots ('that king becomes a bot').
Winner decided by most points at the end.
win_condition: Highest score when the game ends.

board.shape_notes: 14x14 4-player cross (3x3 corners removed) with many stone wall squares forming a labyrinth; small open pockets for each army.
board.theme_notes: grey/white checker with stone-textured wall squares

setup: 4 armies (yellow, blue, green, red) with reduced rows: king, rook, knights etc. plus 2 pawns near own promotion rank; exact maze not legible.
current_impl_issues: Legacy uses 2-player 'maze' with random 14 walls - must be 4-player FFA, 8-check kings, rank-2 promotion and points scoring.
